findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "linkdapi-the-best-linkedin-professional-data-api" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_api_v1_posts_likes, get_api_v1_posts_info, get_api_v1_posts_featured, get_api_v1_posts_comments, get_api_v1_posts_all, get_api_v1_comments_likes, get_api_v1_comments_all, get_api_v1_articles_article_info, get_api_v1_companies_company_posts, get_api_v1_search_posts · Private data: get_api_v1_profile_contact_info · Public sink: get_api_v1_posts_likes, get_api_v1_posts_info, get_api_v1_posts_comments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_api_v1_posts_likes, get_api_v1_posts_info, get_api_v1_posts_featured, get_api_v1_posts_comments, get_api_v1_posts_all, get_api_v1_comments_likes, get_api_v1_comments_all, get_api_v1_articles_article_info, get_api_v1_companies_company_posts, get_api_v1_search_posts · Private data: get_api_v1_profile_contact_info · Public sink: get_api_v1_posts_likes, get_api_v1_posts_info, get_api_v1_posts_comments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
